name: fruit salad
description: Fruit salad is a dish consisting of various kinds of fruit, sometimes served in a liquid, either their juices or a syrup. In different forms, fruit salad can be served as an appetizer or a side as a salad. A fruit salad is sometimes known as a fruit cocktail, or fruit cup
ingredients: strawberries, pineapple, kiwis, grapes, and blueberries, often tossed in a light dressing of honey, lime juice, and zest
instructions: Create a vibrant fruit salad by combining 6–8 cups of chopped, seasonal fruits (such as pineapple, strawberries, kiwi, grapes, and bananas) in a large bowl. Toss with a simple dressing of 2 tbsp honey and 1 tbsp lime/lemon juice to prevent browning and enhance flavor. Chill for 15–30 minutes before serving.
